name: Tissue architecture
failures: Alveolar destruction, nephron loss, cortical disorganisation. A 3-D pattern that cells do not re-derive alone.

see.note: Imaging shows architecture well — this is what CT and MRI are for.

model.note: Positional information is the thing an axolotl has and we lack.

reach.note: You cannot deliver to a pattern.

edit.note: Organoids self-organise in vitro at millimetre scale. Nothing rebuilds architecture in a human.

verify.note: Imaging can confirm structure if it were ever restored.
